list.title: Contracts
list.subtitle: Work you agreed on Vyapar, paid stage by stage. Vyapar keeps each payment safe until the work is approved.
list.emptyBody: When a request is accepted, the person paying can start a contract from the conversation.
list.selectHint: Choose a contract to see its stages and payments.

sandbox.title: Test payments
sandbox.body: Payments run in test mode today: no real money moves. Advance and paid amounts are recorded by Vyapar exactly as they will be when the payment partner goes live.
sandbox.recorded: Advance and paid amounts are recorded by Vyapar. Money reaches the professional once Vyapar's payment partner is live.

new.title: Start a contract
new.subtitle: Agree the work and how it is paid. {{name}} accepts it before anything is charged.
new.secWorkHint: What is being done, in a line the other person recognises.
new.titlePlaceholder: For example: kitchen rewiring for the new oven
new.descPlaceholder: Where, when and anything agreed in the conversation
new.kindHint: A fixed price is paid in stages. Hourly work is paid per approved week.
new.milestonesHint: Each stage is paid when you approve that part of the work.
new.msName: What is done in this stage
new.msTitlePlaceholder: For example: wiring and socket for the oven
new.fillLast: Put the rest in the last one
new.balanced: Stages add up to the total
new.fromProposal: Filled in from {{name}}'s proposal. Change anything you like.
new.notClientBody: The person paying for the work starts the contract. It will appear in your Contracts for you to accept once it is sent.
new.notAccepted: A contract can be started once the request is accepted.
new.howHint: Four steps, and the money is safe at every one.
new.how2: You pay a stage in advance. Vyapar keeps it safe.
new.how4: You approve and it is paid. If you say nothing for 14 days, it is approved for you.
new.errMilestone: Every stage needs a name and an amount.
new.errSum: Stages must add up to the total.
new.errRate: Enter the hourly rate and the weekly hours.
new.notForJobs: Contracts are for projects and local services. A salaried job is paid by the employer directly.
new.notClientBodyPoster: {{name}} posted this work, so {{name}} pays and starts the contract. It will appear in your Contracts for you to accept.
new.notClientBodyRequester: {{name}} asked for this work, so {{name}} pays and starts the contract. It will appear in your Contracts for you to accept.
new.alreadyLive: This conversation already has a contract.

detail.completeHint: Ends the contract. Paid weeks stay paid.
